About Hero Gallery – The Internet’s Hero Section Catalog

name: Hero Gallery
summary: Catalog of 115 live website hero sections, tagged and annotated for layout, copy, CTA and tone.
description: A curated archive of hero sections taken from live websites, each tagged and audited: layout, copy, CTA type, tone of voice and trust signals. Entries link to the original site and add a short written breakdown of why the hero works; new picks are catalogued weekly and mailed out monthly.
contains: filters: category, layout, UI element, color mode, CTA
every entry annotated with layout, copy, CTA and tone notes
tags include industry (SaaS) and site builder (Framer, Webflow)
monthly newsletter and a submit-your-hero form
